meta.note: Gated thought-leadership reports and positioning/campaign landing pages found during the crawl that don't fit the products/solutions/case-studies/blog taxonomy. 'type' is 'report' (downloadable trend report, usually gated behind a form) or 'campaign-landing' (a persuasion/positioning page, e.g. 'Rethink SaaS-only MMM'). Summaries are extracted verbatim from real page text, not written from scratch. Six more items (3 'report' CPT + 3 'download' CPT entries) were recovered by querying /wp-json/wp/v2/report and /wp-json/wp/v2/download directly — these pages had no internal links from anywhere else on the crawled site, so the original link-based crawl never discovered them. Their live-rendered content is thin (title + publish date only, no body text), consistent with being HubSpot form-gated downloads whose real content is a PDF delivered after submission.

resources.title: Data quality at Nepa
resources.summary: Describes Nepa's data quality practices in market research: combining technical fraud-detection (bots, professional survey cheaters, click farms) with survey design (short, engaging surveys with advanced logic).
